title: Nothing but false advertising/ deceptiveness all around
text:
Nothing but false advertising/ deceptiveness all around. This shows a string of multi-colored lights and the listing talks about multiple light settings. What I got was a string of RED flashing led lights. You can't turn the flashing off or change modes no matter what you try The battery compartment only has an on/ off switch and turning it on and off doesn't change the modes either.

The next problem I have is the tree shown in the listing is BUSHY and full, the one they give you- the branches are pencil-thin. They do a row of branches and it's like they then skip a row before adding more... So every other row there's a huge gap and you can try all day to bend and fluff it- you have major gaps and the listing picture does NOT show that. The material the branches are made out of is like a plastic green, the branches are just stringy plastic.

Then you have the ornaments, the stock photo shows more than 2 of several of them.. It comes with two of each ornament and your tree looks very Charlie Brown after getting it together. I'm gonna have to buy some tinsel and more ornaments just to make this look semi-decent.

Overall I could see spending about $5 or 6 max on this. They need to change their listing to stop false advertising though- I feel like I was catfished by the listing and got something way different.
